protocol: train-only full 2x2 visual precision learning with frozen high-resolution pixel measurements and deployed pose backend
training_split: manifest split=train only; development images and labels are not loaded by the trainer
covariance_parameterization: full SPD 2x2 covariance represented by a bounded full relative precision matrix around the regularized original precision; no framewise weight normalization

loss.pose: final translation norm and SO(3) angle from the deployed bounded LiDAR-camera solver, normalized by train-only mean baseline errors
loss.uncertainty: visible-point Gaussian NLL 0.5 e^T P e - 0.5 logdet(P), normalized by train-only mean absolute baseline NLL

selection: fixed final epoch; no development-set checkpoint selection

backend.forward: same bounded L-BFGS-B deployed objective, LiDAR information, bounds, and visual precision weighting
backend.backward: active-set KKT implicit derivative to full precision matrices
backend.finite_nonconverged_policy: retain and report finite solver results only when projected KKT infinity norm is at most the fixed bound
